Class TunableRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.tunable.TunableRegistry
public final class TunableRegistry extends Object

    • resetChangedAfterUpdate

      public static void resetChangedAfterUpdate(TunableBase tunable)
      Resets a tunable's changed flag after the current update cycle finishes.

      Backends should call this after publishing a changed tunable so every alias in every backend can observe the shared changed flag before it is cleared.

      Parameters:
      tunable - tunable to reset

    • runAfterUpdate

      public static void runAfterUpdate(Runnable callback)
      Runs a callback after the current update cycle finishes resetting changed flags.

      Backends should use this for callbacks that react to tuned values so callback mutations are observed as new changes in the next update cycle.

      Parameters:
      callback - callback to run; must not throw

      public static void updateComplexIfNeeded(ComplexTunable tunable)

      tunable - tunable to update

    • withUpdateMutex

      public static void withUpdateMutex(Runnable func)
      Execute a function while holding the same mutex used for update(). As tunables are not thread-safe, this is designed to allow external synchronization for tunables used in secondary threads outside of the robot main loop.

      Every competing access, including main-loop access, must use this method or another safe handoff. The update mutex is held while backends and user callbacks run, so the function should be short and must not allow a mutable tunable value to escape and be accessed after the function completes.

      Parameters:
      func - function to execute

    • reset

      public static void reset()
      Clear all registered types and backends and closes all entries. Should typically only be used by unit test code.
